requirements.statement: Agent Developer validates a governed agent artifact before execution.
Agent OS composes workspace, session, task and lifecycle state without becoming an authorization authority.
Platform SDK preserves tenant, principal, API version, trace and idempotency context.
Agent Platform authorizes the request and remains the sole consequential execution authority.
A real cross-repository HTTP vertical slice executes through Platform and returns evidence/audit references.
Approval is requested at the Platform boundary for the governed operation.
Cancellation, evidence retrieval and event retrieval are exercised in the same causal run.
The E2E workflow checks out exact upstream commits and does not rely on skipped live tests.
A post-phase forensic audit verifies the implementation and CI gate.
